fonts.name: Outfit
fonts.usage: All H1-H6 tags. Must apply 'tracking-tight' for a crisp, technical look.

fonts.name: DM Sans
fonts.usage: All paragraph text, descriptions, and labels.

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.usage: Use specifically for the ROI calculator digits, price counters, floating stat chips, and any data-heavy numeric values.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none text-swara-ink

cream.description: Page Background: Clean Alabaster/Zinc-50. Replaces the old yellow-tinted cream for a crisp, sterile SaaS feel.

sand.description: Section/Alt Background: Cool Zinc-100. Used for secondary sections, 'How it works' background, and subtle floating chips.

white.description: Surface/Cards: Pure white for maximum contrast on bento grids and cards.

ink.description: Primary Text: Deep Slate / Zinc-950. Replaces standard black for a richer, softer contrast.

muted.description: Secondary Text: Cool grey / Zinc-500 for descriptions and inactive states.

primary.description: Replaces 'Swara.maroon'. This is the deep, authoritative slate used for inverted bands (See-it-in-action, Pro pricing, Footer, ROI result card). Provides high-end 'Stripe/Linear' contrast.

accent.description: Replaces 'Swara.gold'. Electric Azure. Used for primary CTA buttons, waveform motifs, active slider tracks, and animated highlights. Gives the 'AI/Tech' kinetic energy.

colors.mapping_instructions: Map the old 'Swara.maroon' tokens to 'Swara.primary' (the dark zinc), and map 'Swara.gold' to 'Swara.accent' (the electric blue). Update the Tailwind config accordingly.

motif.description: Remove all lotus/mandala SVGs. Replace with a modern 'Audio/Voice' and 'SaaS' motif.
motif.implementation: 1. Subtle Grid: Use a background CSS grid pattern (bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:24px_24px]) over the cream background. 2. Soundwaves: Use smooth SVG sine waves or equalizer bars at low opacity (10%) colored in Swara.accent as background textural elements behind the kinetic hero and voice demos.

surfaces.glass: For the sticky navbar: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-200/50. Absolutely NO fully transparent navbars.
surfaces.cards: Bento grids and feature cards must use pure bg-white with a delicate 1px border (border-zinc-200) and a soft ambient shadow: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)].

component_guidelines.navbar: Glassmorphic (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl). Sharp layout. Left: Logo, Middle: Nav Links (text-swara-muted hover:text-swara-ink), Right: CTA Pill.
component_guidelines.hero: Kinetic and bright. Background: Swara.cream + grid motif. Floating stat chips should be Swara.white with subtle shadows. The animated voice demo should use Swara.accent for its pulsing 'speaking' rings.
component_guidelines.inverted_bands: For the 'See it in action' band, 'ROI result card', 'Pro pricing card', and 'Footer': Use Swara.primary (bg-[#09090B]). Text must be inverted to pure white. Accents inside these bands (buttons, active states) use Swara.accent.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). bg-swara-accent text-white hover:bg-blue-700 transition-all active:scale-95.
buttons.secondary: Pill-shaped. bg-white text-swara-ink border border-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-all.
buttons.inverted: For buttons placed ON the inverted bands: bg-white text-swara-primary hover:bg-zinc-100.

component_guidelines.cards_and_bento: Sharp inner corners, moderately rounded outer borders (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl). Keep padding generous (p-8 or p-10). Avoid generic card drop-shadows; rely on 1px borders and extremely diffuse, low-opacity ambient shadows.
component_guidelines.roi_calculator: Sliders should use Swara.accent for the filled track, and Swara.sand for the unfilled track. The 'recovered revenue' result output should be housed in an inverted card (Swara.primary) with JetBrains Mono typography for the numbers.
component_guidelines.pricing_toggle: A subtle pill toggle (bg-swara-sand p-1 rounded-full). The active state should be a white pill with a shadow-sm over it.

grids: Use 12-column subgrids for the bento layout. Features should be asymmetric. Example: one large hero feature spanning 8 columns, with two smaller 4-column features. Maintain consistent 24px (gap-6) spacing.
layouts: Ensure ample negative space. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Content should never feel cramped.
motion: Keep existing framer-motion and Lenis smooth scrolling. Ensure scroll reveals slide up softly (y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1) with an easeOut spring. The animated price counter should tick up smoothly. Ensure 'prefers-reduced-motion' is respected.
accessibility: Ensure WCAG AA compliance. Text-to-background contrast ratios must exceed 4.5:1. Primary accent (#0055FF) on white passes WCAG AA for normal and large text. Ensure all inputs and buttons have a high-contrast focus-visible ring (ring-2 ring-swara-accent ring-offset-2).
logo_advice: USER LOGO UPDATE REQUIRED: Please change your logo color. The Wordmark should be Deep Slate/Black (#09090B) to provide sharp contrast against the light theme. If your logo has a standalone icon, make the icon Electric Azure (#0055FF) to match the new kinetic AI accents. Remove any gold/maroon from the brand assets.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are writing standard React .js files, NOT .tsx. Do not include TypeScript types/interfaces.
Completely eradicate the old Maroon/Gold/Cream color palette in the Tailwind config and component files.
Map the requested palette exactly to the Tailwind tokens provided so the existing structure retains its semantic color references, just with a new aesthetic.
Replace Cormorant Garamond with Outfit for all headings, and replace any ornate serif styling with clean, tracking-tight geometric styling.
Remove any SVG mandalas, lotuses, or Indian motifs. Replace them with technical dots, grids, or CSS audio waveforms.
Ensure all inverted surfaces (footer, see-in-action band, ROI card) correctly use the Swara.primary dark background and invert their child text to white.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered text alignments unless specifically instructed; favor left-aligned, structured typography for a modern SaaS feel.
NEVER use AI emoji characters (ðŸ¤–ðŸ§ ðŸ’¡) for icons. Use Phosphor, Lucide, or Heroicons.
Always apply data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="roi-calculator-slider") to all interactive elements, buttons, and input sliders.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid dark colors with subtle 1px inner borders to create depth.
Ensure no 'AI slop' aesthetics (meaningless purple/pink glowing blobs). Keep it sharp, technical, and grounded.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. E.g., p-8 or p-12 instead of p-4.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for the dropdowns, dialogs, or sticky navbars. Always provide a solid or heavily blurred background to prevent text collision.
